summary_points.text: No proclamations; the council moved to amendments to the mayor's proposed 2017 budget
Councilman Kashmann explained why he did not bring an amendment: the budget has $2.5 million for sidewalks on public property but nothing for homeowners' sidewalk repairs
The mayor committed to set up a committee to develop a program for income-challenged homeowners; public input meetings on the 2017 bond package run from November 15 to December 8
November 7 is the last day for budget amendments, and the council votes on the budget on November 14

decisions.text: No amendments were offered to the mayor's 2017 proposed budget

action_items.task: Bring together a committee of city staff and council representatives to develop a program that eases sidewalk repair costs for income-challenged homeowners
action_items.quote: the mayor committed to bring together a committee of city staff

action_items.task: Vote to adopt or reject the mayor's 2017 proposed budget
action_items.quote: Council will vote to either adopt or reject the mayor's 2017 proposed budgets

action_items.task: Offer any last amendments to the 2017 budget
action_items.spoken_due: Monday, November 7th, will be your last time
